name: Allstate
description: Allstate is the third-largest U.S. personal property and casualty insurer (2024 direct premiums written, A.M. Best, per its 10-K), with 211 million policies in force. Customers pay premiums for auto and homeowners insurance ($57.7B of premiums in 2025; with other revenue, Allstate Protection is 88 percent of consolidated revenue) and Allstate invests the float ($83.2B portfolio). A second, small business sells protection plans, roadside and identity products (Protection Services, $3.6B). 2025 net income applicable to common of $10.2B includes a $1.6B gain on selling its employer voluntary benefits and group health businesses, and Allstate Protection underwriting income rose to $8.7B from $3.2B in 2024 (2025 includes $1.96B of favorable non-catastrophe prior-year reserve reestimates).

employees.note: Approximately 53,000 employees per the 10-K at-a-glance page.

businessLines.name: Allstate Protection
businessLines.how: Households pay premiums for auto (38.1B, 66 percent of the segment's 57.7B of premiums), homeowners (15.4B), other personal lines and some commercial cover under the Allstate, National General, Direct Auto and Answer Financial brands via exclusive agents, independent agents, call centres and online; revenue is premiums earned plus other revenue (2.05B), and profit is premiums less claims (catastrophe losses 4.96B in 2025) and expenses.

operatingProfit.period: FY2025 (year ended 2025-12-31), underwriting income (pre-tax, before investment income)

businessLines.name: Run-off Property-Liability
businessLines.how: Legacy property and casualty policies written decades ago (10-K: from the 1960s onward); no revenue reported; underwriting loss of 154M in 2025.

businessLines.name: Protection Services
businessLines.how: Sells consumer product protection plans (2.16B of revenue), roadside assistance, automotive protection and insurance products, identity protection and Arity data services; customers or retailers pay a fee per plan or per vehicle, and Allstate earns the fee less claims and servicing costs.

operatingProfit.period: FY2025 (year ended 2025-12-31), adjusted net income (after tax)

businessLines.name: Allstate Health and Benefits
businessLines.how: Individual health business only after the employer voluntary benefits and group health businesses were sold in 2025 (2024 revenue 1,883, 2025 revenue 676); earns premiums on health policies less claims.

operatingProfit.period: FY2025 (year ended 2025-12-31), adjusted net income (after tax)

businessLines.name: Corporate
businessLines.how: Holding company activities and non-insurance operations, including strategic-initiative expenses; revenue is mostly net investment income (160).

operatingProfit.period: FY2025 (year ended 2025-12-31), adjusted net loss (after tax)

brands.name: Allstate
brands.note: Core brand, widely known via 'You're In Good Hands With Allstate'.

brands.name: National General
brands.note: Personal lines brand inside Allstate Protection (share of premiums not separately extracted).

brands.name: Allstate Protection Plans, Roadside, Dealer Services, Identity Protection and Arity
brands.note: Protection Services: 3,550M of revenue (5.2 percent of consolidated), protection plans 2,159M.
